description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveTypeAPI class, which handles API operations related to leave types in the OrangeHRM system. It includes test cases for methods such as retrieving, updating, deleting, creating, and listing leave types, utilizing mock services and fixtures to validate behavior.

classes.name: LeaveTypeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveTypeAPI functionalities, including CRUD operations and validation rules, using mocks and fixtures.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads predefined test data fixtures for leave types from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single leave type by ID, mocking data access and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the 'getOne' API method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing leave type, ensuring proper data saving and response normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the 'update' API method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of leave types, including handling of non-existent records.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for deleting leave types.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new leave type, mocking the save operation and verifying the response.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates rules for creating leave types.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all leave types with search and count, mocking data layer responses.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for listing leave types.
